title: feat: adapt better-auth adapter and objects for sys_ prefix naming convention
body:
better-auth hardcodes model names (`user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`) but the protocol layer now requires `sys_` prefixed names. The adapter layer couldn't resolve the correct object definitions, breaking auth flows.

### Adapter mapping (`objectql-adapter.ts`)
- Added `AUTH_MODEL_TO_PROTOCOL` mapping and `resolveProtocolName()` to translate better-auth model names → protocol names
- All 8 adapter operations now route through `resolveProtocolName(model)` instead of passing raw model names
- Unknown models pass through unchanged for extensibility (e.g. better-auth plugins adding custom models)

```typescript
import { AUTH_MODEL_TO_PROTOCOL, resolveProtocolName } from '@objectstack/plugin-auth';

// { user: 'sys_user', session: 'sys_session', account: 'sys_account', verification: 'sys_verification' }
resolveProtocolName('user');    // → 'sys_user'
resolveProtocolName('custom');  // → 'custom' (passthrough)
```

### Object definitions
- `auth-user.object.ts` → `name: 'sys_user'`
- `auth-session.object.ts` → `name: 'sys_session'`
- `auth-account.object.ts` → `name: 'sys_account'`
- `auth-verification.object.ts` → `name: 'sys_verification'`

### Tests
- 11 new tests covering mapping constants, `resolveProtocolName` fallback, and all adapter operations confirming `sys_` names reach `IDataEngine`

### Documentation
- Updated plugin-auth `README.md`, `authentication.mdx`, and `ROADMAP.md` migration notes

> **Breaking change**: Custom adapters or plugins referencing auth objects by name must switch to `sys_`-prefixed protocol names (or import `SystemObjectName` constants). Client-side REST routes (`/api/v1/auth/*`) are unaffected.

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>better-auth适配内核 sys_ 前缀命名和协议表名映射，前端API兼容评估</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 近期已将系统内核对象的协议层命名全部统一为 `sys_` 前缀（详见 [#738](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/issues/738)），但 better-auth 深度集成需要兼容这一变更。
> 
> ## 影响分析
> ### better-auth 核心对象名是硬编码的('user'、'session'、'account'、'verification')，而现在协议层为 'sys_user'、'sys_session' ...。此时：
> - better-auth -> ObjectQL adapter 层调用时依赖 model = 'user'（等四个核心对象名）
> - Auth 对象定义、系统协议层常量已切换为 'sys_user' 等
> 
> 现状会导致 adapter 层找不到正确 object definition，影响认证流程。
> 
> ### 客户端 API 仅通过 HTTP REST 路由（/auth/sign-in, /auth/get-session 等）访问，不直接涉及对象名，前端接口无影响。但如果直接操作对象（如 client.data.find('user', ...)），需要同步切换新协议名。
> 
> ## 必须修正内容
> 1. **adapter(model名到协议object名的映射)**
>     - 在 `objectql-adapter.ts` 增加 model→protocol name 映射，如：{"user":"sys_user",...}
>     - 所有 adapter 函数通过映射表查找 object definition
> 2. **auth对象四个定义文件同步name值**
>     - `auth-user.object.ts`：`name: 'sys_user'`
>     - `auth-session.object.ts`：`name: 'sys_session'`
>     - `auth-account.object.ts`：`name: 'sys_account'`
>     - `auth-verification.object.ts`：`name: 'sys_verification'`
> 3. **配套文档集中更新**
>     - README、authentication.mdx
>     - 补充说明"better-auth对象映射适配"原理、升级影响
> 
> ## ROADMAP动作建议
> - [x] 完成协议层命名规范化 (#738)
> - [ ] 适配 better-auth adapter 与 object 名称同步（本 issue）
> - [ ] 完成端到端 E2E 测试并回归
> - [ ] 更新迁移文档，提醒插件自定义 adapter 必须同步协议层新名称
> 
> ---
> 涉及 breaking change，需团队评审通过。</issue_description>
